question.text: As per exchange specifications, what is the minimum contract value at the time of introduction for a futures trading lot?

explanation.text: The Logic: The trading lot for a futures contract is specified such that the value of the lot at the time of introduction is not less than Rs. 5 lakhs. This means the trading lot is different for each contract and can also vary over time depending on the value of the underlying, especially for single stock futures. The minimum tick size (price step) for futures contracts is Re. 0.05. The Trap: Rs. 2 lakhs is the threshold for retail investor categorization in IPOs, not for derivatives lot size. Rs. 10 lakhs is the SIF investment threshold. Students may confuse various monetary thresholds across different market segments.
